supported_findings.scope: temporal and partition separation for the computational experiment
fixed local observational endpoint in three non-overlapping windows
additive sender/receiver dependence used in the calibration DGP

rejected_findings.claim: general superiority of the non-compensatory contract
independent expert validation of the knowledge profile

reviewer_risks.risk: The frozen prospective superiority endpoint failed.
reviewer_risks.consequence: A manuscript cannot claim that the hard contract is generally more accurate or safer than learned and compensatory alternatives.

reviewer_risks.risk: The author-proposed knowledge profile lacks independent expert content validation.
reviewer_risks.consequence: Formal correctness and computational error rates do not establish domain consensus.

reviewer_risks.risk: The directional diagnostic has substantial prospective error.
reviewer_risks.consequence: Direction and mechanistic authorizations are the dominant false-positive and false-negative source.

reviewer_risks.risk: MICRONS cohorts are internal windows from one observational resource.
reviewer_risks.consequence: Network-robust significance cannot be described as causal or independent biological replication.

reviewer_risks.risk: The node-permutation test assumes residual-array exchangeability.
reviewer_risks.consequence: Unmodeled spatial or cell-class heterogeneity may affect its calibration.

reviewer_risks.risk: Known-truth validation remains low-dimensional and profile-specific.
reviewer_risks.consequence: Cross-domain and realistic neural-system generality remain untested.

reviewer_risks.risk: No human decision-support outcome has been measured.
reviewer_risks.consequence: Usability or improved reviewer decisions cannot be claimed.

recommended_disposition: Retain this package as a transparent negative validation and MICRONS robustness extension. Do not center a new Q1 manuscript on superiority of the current hard contract. A new version requires a better directional evidence model and a separately frozen evaluation partition.
